title: Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage — Notice, Appeal and SNF ABN Figures
content:
The figures governing the Notice of Medicare Non-Coverage (CMS-10123), the expedited Quality Improvement Organization review and the Skilled Nursing Facility Advance Beneficiary Notice (CMS-10055) are the same in all six tiers of Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage.

| Figure | All six tiers |
|---|---|
| NOMNC lead: calendar days before the last covered day by which the NOMNC must be delivered | 2 |
| NOMNC required when coverage ends because the 100 benefit days are used up | No |
| NOMNC required when the resident chooses to leave the center | No |
| QIO request deadline: calendar days before the last covered date on which the deadline falls | 1 (the day before) |
| QIO request deadline hour, local clock, 24-hour | 12 (noon) |
| Liability protection for a resident who requests QIO review after the deadline, for days after the last covered date while the review is pending | No |
| Last covered date when a timely expedited appeal is upheld | The later of the NOMNC's last covered date and the QIO decision date |
| SNF ABN required before non-covered extended care is billed to the resident | Yes |
| Options printed on the SNF ABN | Option 1 — bill Medicare; Option 2 — no bill; Option 3 — stop services |
| Choosing Option 1 obliges the center to submit a demand bill to Medicare | Yes |

### Worked reading on hypothetical dates

For a NOMNC whose last covered date is the 26th of a month:

- the notice must be delivered no later than the 24th, 2 calendar days before the last covered date;
- the expedited QIO request is timely when it is made by 12 noon, local time, on the 25th.
